title: Scheduling and Day-Assignment Puzzles
tagline: Year 3 — Assigning people or tasks to days: before/after, consecutive days, gaps and exclusions

introduction.overview: A scheduling puzzle assigns events to the days of a week. Each day gets one event and each event one day, so it is again a one-to-one ordering with the days as fixed positions. New features are the named anchors (Monday is the first, Sunday the last), the phrase "consecutive days", and exclusion clues such as "not on Friday". The method is the usual one: anchors, chains, gap arithmetic, exclusions last.
introduction.placementRelevance: Scheduling sets with seven days are among the commonest arrangement puzzles in written tests.
introduction.realWorldContext: Timetables, shift rosters and appointment calendars use the same one-per-slot logic.

learningObjectives: Convert "k days between" into a difference of k + 1

prerequisiteKnowledge.quickRefresher: Monday is day 1 and Sunday day 7 in this chapter. "Earlier in the week" means a smaller day number.

coreDefinitions: Consecutive days: day numbers that differ by 1.
Immediately before: the day with the number one less.
k days between: day numbers differ by k + 1.
Exclusion clue: "not on Friday" removes one option for one person.
One-to-one: every day has exactly one event.
conceptExplanation.theoreticalIntuition: The week is a row of seven slots. Each clue ties two people to slot numbers, so you are solving the same ordering problem as before.
conceptExplanation.visualOrMentalModel: Write Monday to Sunday as 1 to 7. Place the day-named anchors, build chains, fit the gaps, apply exclusions, and verify.

mainNarrative: Take seven employees and the clues: Chitra on Monday, Fatima on Sunday, Eshan on Thursday, Girish the day before Eshan, Anita earlier in the week than Girish, Bharat earlier than Deepak. Start with the day anchors: Chitra 1, Fatima 7, Eshan 4. Girish is immediately before Eshan, so Girish is day 3. Anita is earlier than Girish and the only free earlier day is 2, so Anita is Tuesday. Bharat and Deepak take days 5 and 6 with Bharat earlier: Friday and Saturday.
A "not on" clue is a tie-breaker. Use it only after the main structure leaves two options.
"Consecutive days" does not say which comes first, so it gives two possibilities. Test both against the other clues.
For gap clues, "exactly two days between" means a difference of 3 days. If one is on Thursday (day 4), the other is on Monday or Sunday.
For exchange questions, write the week again, swap the two named people and read the answer from the new week.

deepDiveAspects.title: Consecutive vs immediately before
deepDiveAspects.content: "Consecutive" is symmetric; "immediately before" fixes the order.

deepDiveAspects.title: Week boundaries
deepDiveAspects.content: Do not wrap from Sunday to Monday unless the problem says the schedule is cyclic.

solvedExamples.title: Chain
solvedExamples.question: Eshan has the meeting on Thursday and Girish's meeting is on the day immediately before Eshan's. On which day is Girish's meeting?

steps.title: Read the clue
steps.explanation: Girish's day is exactly one day earlier than Eshan's Thursday.

steps.title: Day before
steps.explanation: The day before Thursday is Wednesday.

solvedExamples.title: Gap clue
solvedExamples.question: Exactly two days lie between the meetings of Deepak and Girish. If Girish's meeting is on Thursday, on which days can Deepak's be?

solvedExamples.title: Counting after
solvedExamples.question: In the week Chitra, Anita, Girish, Eshan, Bharat, Deepak, Fatima (Monday to Sunday), how many meetings are held after Eshan's?

traditionalVsShortcut.shortcutMethod: Number the days 1 to 7, place the named anchors, then chains, then gaps, then exclusions.

placementTips.eliminationTechnique: Strike out each day as you assign it.
placementTips.questionSelectionAdvice: Use exclusion clues only at the end.

easy.question:
Seven employees Anita, Bharat, Chitra, Deepak, Eshan, Fatima and Girish each have exactly one meeting with the manager, on different days from Monday to Sunday (one meeting per day, in that order). The following facts are known:
1. Chitra has the meeting on Monday.
2. Fatima has the meeting on Sunday.
3. Eshan has the meeting on Thursday.
4. Girish's meeting is on the day immediately before Eshan's.
5. Anita's meeting is earlier in the week than Girish's.
6. Bharat's meeting is earlier in the week than Deepak's.

Whose meeting is on Monday?
easy.explanation: From Monday to Sunday the meetings are held by Chitra, Anita, Girish, Eshan, Bharat, Deepak, Fatima, so Chitra is the answer.
